tier_anchors.notes: Full custom and premium semi-custom with all-plywood standard, dovetail drawers, Blum hardware
Semi-custom with strong finish and hardware but particleboard base config
Entry semi-custom and modular systems. Adequate construction, limited differentiation.
Builder-grade. Thermofoil, light-density particleboard, generic hardware, 1-year warranty.
No calibration products. Reserved for products failing KCMA baseline or with documented structural defects.

quality.notes: M-grade = medium density. LD = light density (lowest screw pull-out, moisture failure 3-5 yrs)
Dovetail = strongest joint. Dado-rabbet = adequate. Cam-lock = RTA-grade, weakest.
CV = conversion varnish, most durable factory finish. TFL/thermofoil = delamination risk near heat.
1/2 plywood = structural. 1/4 hardboard = standard. 1/8 = flexes under load.
Framed +1 (KCMA base-front joint test data). Frameless + plywood = compensated. Frameless + particleboard = real vulnerability, stacks with substrate penalty.
Same rule as countertops. Single plant or identifiable origin = +1.

performance.notes: Blum CLIP top = 165K. Generic = 25-30K. Hardware brand IS the spec.
Blum MOVENTO = 100K. Blum TANDEM PLUS = 75K. Generic side-mount = 25-35K.
Standard = included at no extra cost. False = available as upgrade or absent.

durability.notes: KCMA = floor, not differentiator. 40-50% fail first attempt. Absence is meaningful.
Score on term length + backing entity viability. Industry-standard exclusions (water damage, humidity, improper install) do NOT reduce score. Rule 18.

scoring_rules: Health certs report-only, no composite impact (CARB, TSCA, GREENGUARD Gold)
KCMA = floor (0 if yes, -2 if no)
Source traceability same as countertops (+1 single source, 0 multi, -1 unknown)
Score base configuration, note upgrade availability (Rule 17)
Frame type conditional on substrate (Rule: framed/frameless/frameless+particleboard)
Corporate structure = report finding only (MasterBrand disclosure)
Hardware brand and grade = verifiable performance data
Warranty exclusion consistency: industry-standard exclusions do NOT reduce score (Rule 18)
Score the product not the brand: different configs under same brand = separate scores (Rule 19)
Pool S vacant — no independent teardown source identified for cabinets
